title: How Political Advertising Will Impact the Media Landscape in 2026

facts.fact: The 2022 midterms saw $8.9 billion in political ad spending, per the page's citation of AdImpact figures.
facts.quote: a 20%-plus increase over the 2022 midterms’ $8.9 billion

facts.fact: Total political ad spending in the 2024 presidential cycle was $11.2 billion.
facts.quote: nearly on par with the $11.2 billion spent during the 2024 presidential cycle.

facts.fact: The presidential race alone accounted for $3.2 billion of 2024 political ad spending.
facts.quote: with the presidential race alone accounting for $3.2 billion

facts.fact: House race ad spending is projected to reach $2.2 billion in 2026, the first time the chamber exceeds $2 billion.
facts.quote: Spending on House races, on the other hand, is projected to reach $2.2 billion

facts.fact: Downballot spending from ballot propositions and state legislative races is expected to account for 36% of all 2026 political ad spending, or $3.9 billion.
facts.quote: will account for 36% of all political ad spending, representing $3.9 billion

facts.fact: California is projected to lead all states with $1.1 billion in 2026 political ad spending.
facts.quote: California is projected to lead all states at $1.1 billion in political spending

facts.fact: New Jersey's 2026 gubernatorial race is expected to more than triple its 2021 ad investment.
facts.quote: New Jersey’s race alone expected to more than triple its 2021 investment

facts.fact: Of the projected 40 competitive House seats, 12 sit in the New York and Los Angeles metropolitan areas.
facts.quote: 12 of the projected 40 competitive seats sit in those two metropolitan areas

facts.fact: All 435 US House seats will be contested in the 2026 midterms.
facts.quote: All 435 House seats will be contested

facts.fact: The Senate currently has a 53-47 Republican majority.
Basis's platform data shows roughly 50% of a cycle's political dollars ran in the 30 days before Election Day.
facts.quote: shows that roughly 50% of a cycle’s political dollars run in the 30 days before Election Day, with about 25% concentrated in the final 10 days

facts.fact: Basis's platform data shows about 25% of a cycle's political dollars ran in the final 10 days before Election Day.
facts.quote: with about 25% concentrated in the final 10 days

facts.fact: The FIFA World Cup is hosted in the US, Canada, and Mexico from June through July and will drive demand for sports-adjacent inventory.
facts.quote: The FIFA World Cup, hosted in the US, Canada, and Mexico from June through July
